استصدرت (form X)
# اِسْتَصْدَرْتُ (istaṣdartu) /is.tasˤ.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اِسْتَصْدَرْتَ (istaṣdarta) /is.tasˤ.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اِسْتَصْدَرْتِ (istaṣdarti) /is.tasˤ.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اِسْتَصْدَرَتْ (istaṣdarat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
